look: Crystalweb Broodmother, a C-rank GKOM variant from the Veinweb Spiders family: huge broodmother spider whose back is a nest of hatching crystal eggs. Family anatomy: giant spiders with crystal-tipped legs and black vein-like silk. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystal plates over shoulders, back and limbs; about a third of the body crystallised; the crystals are black vein crystal. A fist-sized GKOM core orb, deep red with internal light, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, clear shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils
